annotations.title: Exact price for a home cleaning

description: Exact price (same calculation as menageparfait.fr): TTC (show this to the customer), HT, VAT, and the cost after the 50% tax credit if the customer is eligible.

condition.description: ASK the customer, never assume: when the home last had a thorough (professional) clean. recent (<1 month), one_to_six_months, over_six_months (or never). First cleanings are rarely recent.

extras.description: Extras from get_services. Ask the customer before quoting a first cleaning: most add at least one (inside the oven id 11, inside the fridge id 10, windows id 15 with quantity, changing sheets id 12; move-out: Fin de bail id 18). e.g. [{"id":11},{"id":15,"quantity":4}]

frequency.description: once, weekly, biweekly (every 2 weeks) or monthly — recurring plans get a discount

furnished_occupied.description: Home is furnished and lived in

surface_m2.description: Living area in m² (optional, improves accuracy)

name: get_quote
